messages.text: I applied for a refund on my seat cushion while I was still within the deadline, but the staff member rejected it. Surely that first request keeps my refund window open?

messages.text:
No. The first proposal was rejected, so it does not keep the refund window open for a later request. A rejected proposal is excluded from the late-request exception; the 30-day deadline still applies (refund-policy/v2/window).

Your seat cushion was recorded as returned, and the shop’s return records determine that (refund-policy/v2/return). The order’s recorded delivery was October 9, 2026, so the normal request deadline was November 8, 2026, at 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window).
